cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Test the Story First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to repeat the explanation, ask the dangerous question, or test the risky step before you commit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Try this banking-delay explanation for the missing raffle money on the chair before I sign it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not defending your accounts again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Just test the explanation. If she accepts it, I'll sign and handle every question.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll recognise your handwriting before I speak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the paper. Ask whether a banking delay sounds plausible. If she asks whose money, come back before answering.

mechanism: A supervises a low-attribution test of an explanation before attaching their name to it.
confusable: Ordinary delegation lacks the conditional commitment; A must wait for B's test before endorsing the story.
comparison: Chair-facing explanation trial differs from testing a parent's reaction to upgrades.
seedUse: Use banking delay and raffle payment; emphasize testing the claim rather than pretending B owns the accounts.
